phase: Phase 7 (NOT LOCKED): learning from incomplete programs, method consolidation and transfer

transfers.when: Stage 1 closed at 276.6/300 s, before any Stage 2 or target outcome
transfers.why: unused Stage 1 funds move forward to evaluation margin

notes: Stage 3 (improver campaign) is 0 s by default; up to 520 s may move from eval to meta before any Stage 2 outcome only if Stage 4 demonstrably still covers all 648 main rows, 108 panel rows and a margin.
Only unused earlier-stage funds move forward, logged before target outcomes; reporting funds are not borrowed.

Stage 3 decision (made before any Stage 2 outcome, from Stage 1 timing): DEFERRED. The evaluation rehearsal projects ~1.2 s per row, so 648 main rows need ~800 s of the 950 s Stage 4 allocation; moving up to 520 s to Stage 3 would leave Stage 4 unable to cover all 648 main rows plus 108 panel rows with a margin. The improver comparator (lineage7.meta_compare / judge_edit) is implemented and unit-tested; the agi7de/panel range stays UNOPENED; the improver claim is reported as untested.

Within-lineage improver rollouts are also not run in Stage 2: a paired rollout must span several complete learn/admit/use cycles per clone, which a 300 s job cannot contain next to its own learning. Both cohorts keep M0 (no eligible tested M change exists).
